body_markdown:
BrainsWay will be participating in the IV Jornadas de Actualizaciones en Neuromodulación, taking place on September 24–25, 2026, in Seville, Spain.


[Dr. Colleen A. Hanlon, PhD, Vice President of Global Medical Affairs at BrainsWay](https://www.linkedin.com/in/colleen-hanlon/) , will present “Updates in Deep TMS: Swift Protocol and New Clinical Horizons” during the BrainsWay Satellite Symposium on September 25.


For full event details, please visit:
[https://psiquiatriaclinica.es/eventos-y-jornadas/iv-jornadas-de-actualizaciones-en-neuromodulacion/](https://psiquiatriaclinica.es/eventos-y-jornadas/iv-jornadas-de-actualizaciones-en-neuromodulacion/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
